title: A C^1 representative of a W^{1,2}(B) function has gradient equal to the weak gradient
statement: Let n >= 1, B the open unit ball of R^n, and let w : R^n -> R, g : R^n -> R^n satisfy IsW12WithGradient w g B. Let u : R^n -> R be C^1 at every point of B (ContDiffAt R 1 u x for all x in B) with u = w almost everywhere on B. Then grad u = g almost everywhere on B.
lean_statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ (w u : Rn n → ℝ) (g : Rn n → Rn n), IsW12WithGradient w g (ball 0 1) → (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 u x) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) 1)), u x = w x) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) 1)), gradient u x = g x
